title: Neon Slither Arena
description: Massive multiplayer snake survival arena. Collect glowing energy orbs, boost to outmaneuver rivals, trap opponents, and dominate the live leaderboard!
instructions: Slither around the vast arena collecting glowing energy orbs to grow longer and thicker.
Do NOT hit another snake's body head-first or you will explode into collectible orbs!
Cut off opponents so their heads crash into your body to eliminate them and absorb their mass.
Boost with Left Click or Space (or touch button) for sudden speed bursts at the cost of a little mass.
Choose from 12 neon cyber skins and climb to #1 on the real-time leaderboard!
controls: Mouse or Touch to steer smoothly in any direction
Hold Left Mouse Button, Right Click, or Spacebar to boost
On Mobile: Virtual joystick or touch-follow with dedicated Boost button
Press ESC or P to pause single-player mode; F for fullscreen
